title: ws-voice-signal (app to server)

scope.description: run: the joined participants of the run; session: the owner and the viewers of the Session.

to_device_id.description: A device in the same voice room.

from_device_id.description: Server to app only: the sending device.

description: WebRTC signaling between two devices of the same voice room, like signal for Sessions. Further fields (sdp, candidate, mid, ...) are passed on verbatim and never parsed; the server removes to_device_id and adds from_device_id. The sender must be in the room and the target must be a connected device in it, else error forbidden (not_found when the target is not connected). The app uses the ICE servers it already has from hello_ack and ice_update; no extra TURN data is sent for voice. Server to app: the same message with from_device_id instead of to_device_id. Needs together_v1.
